headline: Sarvam signs five-year AI framework MoU with HQ IDS for Army, Navy, Air Force
quote: setting up an umbrella framework for AI projects across the Indian Army, the Indian Navy and the Indian Air Force
claim: Sarvam says it signed an MoU with Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff, setting up an umbrella framework for AI projects across the Army, Navy and Air Force; work will be done by its defence division Chanakya using models such as Sarvam 105B.
why_it_matters: Indian-built foundation models are now being contracted for defence work, a sign of where sovereign AI jobs and projects are heading.
title: Sarvam and Ministry of Defence sign AI MoU | Sarvam AI

headline: Cognizant reportedly in talks to invest in Sarvam at $3.5-4 Bn valuation
quote: Cognizant is reportedly in talks to invest in Sarvam AI as part of a proposed $300 Mn fundraise at a $3.5-4 Bn valuation
claim: Inc42 reports Cognizant is in talks to invest in Sarvam AI as part of a proposed $300 Mn fundraise at a $3.5-4 Bn valuation; Sarvam raised $234 Mn in the first close of its $300 Mn Series B in June at a $1.5 Bn valuation. Unconfirmed report.
why_it_matters: Big IT services firms are buying into Indian model builders, which signals where enterprise AI hiring may flow.
title: Cognizant In Talks To Invest In Sarvam At $3.5 Bn To $4 Bn Valuation: Report

headline: Simplismart raises $14 Mn Series B led by Dallas Venture Capital
quote: Simplismart raised $14 million in a Series B round led by Dallas Venture Capital, with NVIDIA, Accel, Shastra VC and Micromax also investing.
claim: Bengaluru-based Simplismart raised $14 million in a Series B led by Dallas Venture Capital, with NVIDIA, Accel, Shastra VC and Micromax investing; it says its annual revenue run rate grew 14 times in six months.
why_it_matters: Inference-cost tooling built in Bengaluru is attracting NVIDIA money, so infra skills are in demand.
title: Daily Indian Funding Roundup & Key News - 28 October 2026: Simplismart Raises $14 Million, Jio Platforms Lists at 21% Premium

headline: AI startups raised $30.4 Mn in Indian week of 26-31 October
quote: AI was second-placed this week, with five startups raising $30.4 Mn.
claim: Inc42 says AI was the second-placed sector in weekly Indian startup funding, with five startups raising $30.4 Mn; Simplismart's $14 Mn and Live2.ai's $13.7 Mn made up 91% of it.
why_it_matters: Shows how thin Indian AI funding was this week: two rounds were nearly all of it.
title: Indian Startups Raised Over $132 Mn This Week
